title: 2030 — First line hulls products reach price parity: jackfruit supply c
definition: 2030 milestone on the Jackfruit Product Lines roadmap.
description:
First line hulls products reach price parity: jackfruit supply cultivation at commercial scale.

definition: Estimates Jackfruit Product Lines readiness from component maturity.
description:

Honest scoring is the point: a line hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Jackfruit Product Lines Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Jackfruit Product Lines operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Jackfruit Product Lines installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 66899 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where jackfruit supply monitoring, line logistics redundancy, or processing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Jackfruit Product Lines Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Jackfruit Product Lines: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Jackfruit Product Lines — jackfruit as a mainstream meat alternative.

Phase 1 — Prove (jackfruit supply): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (line logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (processing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (flavor ranges): line hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and retail-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
